description: This file serves as the main entry point for a GUI application built with the Fyne toolkit. It manages the creation and organization of multiple tab views such as Topology, Policy, SSID, WiFi Radio, WiFi Channel, Neighbors, and Client Devices. It also handles periodic background updates, menu setup, and application window initialization. The application interacts with external C code via cgo, executing commands and updating the interface based on external network data.
external_files: C headers included via cgo: em_cli_apis.h
Resource images: resourceGatewayPng, resourcePolicyPng, resourceSsidPng, resourceWifiradioPng, resourceWifiChannelPng, resourceWifiNeighborsPng, resourceDeviceConnectionPng
